questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements concerning Robert L. Katz’s skill-mix theory of management:
I. Human (interpersonal) skills maintain vital importance across all tiers of the administrative hierarchy.
II. Top-level administrative leaders rely extensively on conceptual skills to craft institutional vision and strategic plans.
III. Technical skills become completely redundant and obsolete upon reaching top-level executive leadership.
IV. Conceptual skills encompass the cognitive capacity to interpret ambiguous data and diagnose complex organizational dynamics.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (a).
Statement I is correct: Human skills (empathy, communication, motivation, leadership) are universally required across all organizational levels because every manager must interact with people.
Statement II is correct: Top-level executives require superior conceptual skills to set institutional direction, balance competing priorities, and formulate long-range policies.
Statement III is incorrect: Technical skills do not become completely obsolete at top levels; while top executives do not routinely perform hands-on technical work, a solid foundational grasp of technical operations is still needed to evaluate proposals, understand constraints, and make informed choices.
Statement IV is correct: Conceptual skills inherently involve abstract cognitive processing, systems thinking, and solving complex, unstructured problems.
Thus, statements I, II, and IV are correct, making option (a) the correct answer.

सही उत्तर (a) है।
कथन I सही है: मानवीय कौशल संगठन के प्रत्येक स्तर (पर्यवेक्षी, मध्य और शीर्ष) पर अनिवार्य होते हैं क्योंकि सभी प्रबंधकों को व्यक्तियों के साथ कार्य करना और उनका मार्गदर्शन करना होता है।

अतः कथन I, II और IV सही हैं।

Katz’s skill-mix model, as an educational professional ascends from operational frontline supervision to senior executive leadership (e.g., from a classroom supervisor to a Director of Education), the relative necessity of which skill diminishes most significantly?
options_english: Technical skills

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). According to Katz's managerial skill model, the required mix of skills shifts dynamically across hierarchical levels. At lower operational levels, specialized technical skills are paramount for day-to-day supervision. As an administrator rises to top management (e.g., Director of Education or Vice-Chancellor), executive duties shift from specialized instructional procedures toward broad strategic planning, institutional policy-making, and systemic governance. Consequently, the proportional demand for hands-on technical skills decreases, while the requirement for conceptual skills increases dramatically. Human/interpersonal skills remain equally essential at all managerial tiers. Options (b), (c), and (d) are incorrect because conceptual skills increase, and human/interpersonal skills remain constant across levels.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। रॉबर्ट एल. काट्ज़ के मॉडल के अनुसार, पदानुक्रम में ऊपर बढ़ने पर आवश्यक कौशलों का अनुपात परिवर्तित होता है। निचले स्तर पर दिन-प्रतिदिन के कार्यों के संपादन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए तकनीकी कौशल सबसे महत्वपूर्ण होते हैं। परंतु जैसे ही कोई अधिकारी शीर्ष प्रबंधन (जैसे शिक्षा निदेशक) पर पहुँचता है, उसका कार्य क्षेत्र व्यापक नीतियों, रणनीतिक नियोजन और व्यवस्थागत समन्वय पर केंद्रित हो जाता है। अतः तकनीकी कौशल की प्रत्यक्ष आवश्यकता आनुपातिक रूप से घट जाती है, जबकि संकल्पनात्मक कौशल की आवश्यकता अत्यधिक बढ़ जाती है। मानवीय (अंतरवैयक्तिक) कौशल सभी स्तरों पर समान रूप से आवश्यक बने रहते हैं। अतः विकल्प (a) सही है।

questions.question_english: The Blake-Mouton Managerial Grid identifies an 'Impoverished Management' leadership style, which is characterized by which of the following orientations?
options_english: High concern for people and low concern for production
Low concern for production and low concern for people
High concern for production and low concern for people
High concern for production and high concern for people
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). The Blake-Mouton Managerial Grid, developed by Robert Blake and Jane Mouton, evaluates leadership styles along two distinct behavioral dimensions: concern for production (task orientation on the horizontal axis) and concern for people (relationship orientation on the vertical axis), each scored from 1 to 9. The 'Impoverished Management' style corresponds to coordinate (1,1), reflecting minimal concern for both organizational output and employee well-being. Leaders exhibiting this style exert the bare minimum effort necessary to maintain their position within the organization, effectively displaying an evasive, laissez-faire orientation. In contrast, Option (a) corresponds to Country Club Management (1,9); Option (c) corresponds to Authority-Compliance / Task Management (9,1); and Option (d) corresponds to Team Management (9,9).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। रॉबर्ट ब्लैक और जेन माउटन द्वारा प्रतिपादित प्रबंधकीय ग्रिड (Managerial Grid) नेतृत्व शैलियों को दो प्रमुख आयामों के आधार पर वर्गीकृत करता है: उत्पादन के प्रति सरोकार (क्षैतिज अक्ष पर कार्य-उन्मुखता) और व्यक्तियों के प्रति सरोकार (ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर संबंध-उन्मुखता), दोनों को 1 से 9 के पैमाने पर मापा जाता है। निर्देशांक (1,1) पर स्थित 'दरिद्र प्रबंधन' (Impoverished Management) शैली में उत्पादन और व्यक्तियों दोनों के प्रति निम्नतम सरोकार दर्शाया जाता है। इस शैली को अपनाने वाले प्रबंधक संगठन में केवल अपनी नौकरी बनाए रखने के लिए न्यूनतम प्रयास करते हैं और उत्तरदायित्वों से बचते हैं। विकल्प (a) 'कंट्री क्लब प्रबंधन' (1,9) का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है; विकल्प (c) 'सत्ता-अनुपालन या कार्य प्रबंधन' (9,1) को दर्शाता है; तथा विकल्प (d) 'टीम प्रबंधन' (9,9) को इंगित करता है।

questions.question_english: What is the fundamental premise underlying the “Trait Theory” of leadership?
options_english: Effective leadership behavior can be systematically taught and developed in any individual through structured training
Leaders naturally possess inherent, stable personal traits and qualities that distinguish them from non-leaders
Leadership success is primarily determined by matching administrative decision-making styles to specific situations
Leadership operates fundamentally as a transactional exchange process of rewards and compliance between managers and staff
questions.explanation_english:
The Trait Theory of leadership (rooted historically in Thomas Carlyle's 'Great Man' theory) posits that leaders are born rather than made. It asserts that successful leaders naturally possess inherent personality characteristics, cognitive abilities, and physical traits—such as intelligence, emotional stability, self-confidence, initiative, and integrity—that differentiate them from non-leaders. This approach focuses on identifying core universal traits that predispose individuals to effective leadership across diverse organizational settings.
- Option A is incorrect because the premise that leadership can be systematically taught and cultivated through training is central to Behavioral and Developmental theories of leadership, not Trait Theory.
- Option C is incorrect because matching leadership styles to situational contingencies is the core principle of Contingency and Situational theories (e.g., Fiedler's Contingency Model, Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership).
- Option D is incorrect because viewing leadership as a reciprocal exchange of contingent rewards and compliance is the basis of Transactional Leadership theory.
questions.explanation_hindi:
नेतृत्व का 'विशेषता सिद्धांत' (Trait Theory—जो ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'महान व्यक्ति सिद्धांत' से जुड़ा है) यह मानता है कि नेता जन्मजात होते हैं, बनाए नहीं जाते। इस सिद्धांत की मूल धारणा यह है कि सफल नेताओं में कुछ जन्मजात, स्थायी व्यक्तित्व लक्षण, बौद्धिक क्षमताएं और शारीरिक गुण (जैसे उच्च बुद्धि, आत्मविश्वास, संवेगात्मक स्थिरता, निर्णय क्षमता और ईमानदारी) होते हैं जो उन्हें सामान्य व्यक्तियों से अलग और श्रेष्ठ बनाते हैं।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि नेतृत्व व्यवहार को प्रशिक्षण द्वारा सिखाए जाने की धारणा 'व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांतों' (Behavioral Theories) की है।
- विकल्प (B) सही है क्योंकि यह विशेषता सिद्धांत की मूल मान्यता को सटीक रूप से व्यक्त करता है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि प्रशासनिक शैली को स्थिति के अनुसार ढालना 'परिस्थितिपरक या आकस्मिकता सिद्धांतों' (Situational/Contingency Theories) का आधार है।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि पुरस्कार और अनुपालन के लेन-देन पर आधारित नेतृत्व 'संव्यवहारात्मक नेतृत्व' (Transactional Leadership) का लक्षण है।

questions.question_english: Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory of motivation is based on the formulation: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence. In this context, what does 'Valence' refer to?
options_english: The cognitive expectation that increased personal effort will result in a successful performance evaluation
The subjective value, desirability, or attractiveness an individual assigns to an organizational reward
The perceived probability that achieving a high performance appraisal will result in receiving a reward
The quantitative assessment of emotional strain or mental stress experienced while performing duties
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, motivation is determined by Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence. Expectancy is the belief that effort leads to performance (Option A). Instrumentality is the perceived probability that performance will lead to an outcome/reward (Option C). Valence specifically represents the value, desirability, or personal importance an individual places on an expected organizational outcome or reward (Option B). If an employee values the offered reward highly, valence is positive, thereby enhancing overall motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। विक्टर व्रूम के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत में अभिप्रेरणा तीन घटकों के गुणनफल पर निर्भर करती है: (1) प्रत्याशा (Expectancy): यह विश्वास कि प्रयास से बेहतर प्रदर्शन होगा (विकल्प A)। (2) साधनता (Instrumentality): यह विश्वास कि बेहतर प्रदर्शन से पुरस्कार प्राप्त होगा (विकल्प C)। (3) संयोजकता (Valence): किसी प्रतिफल या पुरस्कार के प्रति व्यक्ति का आकर्षण या व्यक्तिपरक मूल्य (विकल्प B)। यदि कोई कर्मचारी मिलने वाले पुरस्कार को अत्यंत मूल्यवान मानता है, तो संयोजकता धनात्मक और उच्च होगी।

Case: A School Principal observes that the Mathematics department consistently delays submitting internal assessment marks. Instead of issuing a formal punitive memo immediately, the Principal speaks with the Head of Department to understand the bottleneck. The HOD explains that the software is glitchy. The Principal promptly contacts IT support to resolve the technical issue.
This situation represents the manager acting primarily in which capacity?
options_english: A rigid disciplinary authority focused strictly on enforcing penalties for non-compliance
A ceremonial figurehead dedicated to fulfilling symbolic, formal management duties
A non-programmed crisis strategist managing unprecedented organizational emergencies

questions.explanation_english:
In educational management, diagnosing the underlying cause of an administrative bottleneck before taking action reflects effective diagnostic problem-solving capacity:
- Rather than immediately resorting to punitive reprimands (Option A), the Principal investigates root causes through collaborative dialogue with department leadership. Discovering that the delay is caused by technical software defects rather than teacher apathy, the Principal mobilizes technical support to eliminate the systemic hurdle. This demonstrates supportive, diagnostic problem-solving aimed at smoothing institutional workflows (Option D).
- Option B (Figurehead) refers to ceremonial and symbolic social duties.
- Option C refers to managing unprecedented macro crises, which does not fit routine software debugging.

questions.question_english: Under the statutory mandate of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what is the mandatory minimum frequency for convening School Management Committee (SMC) meetings?
options_english: At least once every week
At least once every month
At least once in two months
At least twice in an academic year
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Under Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, and its implementing model rules, every government and aided elementary school must establish a School Management Committee (SMC) comprising parents (at least 75%), local authority representatives, and teachers. The rules explicitly mandate that the SMC must convene at least once every month. Monthly meetings ensure continuous participatory governance, monitoring of student attendance, oversight of school meal programs, tracking of infrastructure grants, and preparation of the annual School Development Plan (SDP).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 21 तथा संबंधित मॉडल नियमों के अनुसार, सभी सरकारी और सहायता प्राप्त प्रारंभिक विद्यालयों में विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) का गठन अनिवार्य है। वैधानिक नियमों के तहत SMC की बैठक महीने में कम से कम एक बार आयोजित करना अनिवार्य किया गया है। प्रतिमाह बैठक आयोजित करने से विद्यालयी विकास योजना (SDP) की समीक्षा, वित्तीय अनुदानों की निगरानी, मध्याह्न भोजन कार्यक्रम का पर्यवेक्षण और समुदाय आधारित पारदर्शी शासन सुनिश्चित होता है।

The Principal forms a committee of language teachers to recommend titles within budgetary constraints, issues proper tenders, receives the consignments, and ensures they are cataloged into the library accession register before processing vendor payments.
In this context, ensuring books are entered into the accession register serves which core managerial function?

questions.explanation_english:

2. It prevents fiscal irregularities, inventory misappropriation, duplicate billing, and procurement fraud.

questions.question_english: Which leadership theory argues that a leader's primary function is to facilitate subordinates' goal achievement by clarifying the path, providing necessary guidance and support, and removing operational obstacles?
options_english: Path-Goal Theory
Trait Theory
Transformational Theory
Theory X
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Robert House's Path-Goal Theory of leadership (derived from Vroom's expectancy theory of motivation) asserts that leaders are effective when they clear the path for subordinates to achieve work goals. Leaders do this by providing direction and support, reducing organizational roadblocks, coaching, and making the attainment of outcomes personally satisfying. House identifies four situational leadership behaviors to accomplish this: Directive, Supportive, Participative, and Achievement-Oriented. Option (b), Trait Theory, focuses on inherent physical or psychological traits of leaders. Option (c), Transformational Theory, centers on charismatic vision and organizational transformation. Option (d), Theory X, assumes employees are inherently averse to work and require coercion.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। रॉबर्ट हाउस द्वारा विकसित 'मार्ग-लक्ष्य सिद्धांत' (Path-Goal Theory) यह स्थापित करता है कि नेता की मुख्य भूमिका अधीनस्थों को उनके व्यक्तिगत और संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में सहायता करना है। इसके लिए नेता लक्ष्यों तक पहुँचने का रास्ता स्पष्ट करता है, आवश्यक मार्गदर्शन, कोचिंग और संसाधन उपलब्ध कराता है तथा कार्यमार्ग में आने वाली प्रशासनिक या परिचालन संबंधी बाधाओं को दूर करता है। हाउस ने इसके लिए चार प्रकार के नेतृत्व व्यवहार (निर्देशात्मक, सहायक, सहभागी और उपलब्धि-उन्मुख) बताए हैं। विकल्प (b) शील-गुण सिद्धांत नेता के जन्मजात व्यक्तित्व लक्षणों पर बल देता है। विकल्प (c) रूपांतरणकारी सिद्धांत संस्थागत मूल्यों के कायाकल्प पर केंद्रित है। विकल्प (d) थ्योरी X कर्मचारियों को कामचोर मानकर नियंत्रण पर बल देती है।

questions.question_english: In modern public administration, accountability frameworks operate in multiple dimensions (upward, downward, and horizontal/lateral). Which of the following relationships represents an example of ‘Downward Accountability’?
options_english: The Principal submitting quarterly expenditure and compliance reports to the Directorate of Education
The Principal and school administration being answerable to the students, parents, and local community
The Principal answering audit queries raised by the State Legislative Public Accounts Committee
Classroom teachers reporting daily instructional progress and student evaluation data to the Principal
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). Accountability in public institutions functions across three key dimensions:
1. Upward Accountability: Where institutional leaders report hierarchically to higher administrative and regulatory authorities, such as the Directorate of Education, Ministry, or legislative oversight bodies (Options a and c).
2. Downward Accountability: Where public officials and school managers remain answerable, transparent, and responsive to the primary clients, service beneficiaries, and end-users they serve—namely students, parents, and the local community (Option b).
3. Lateral/Horizontal Accountability: Where professionals remain accountable to peers, professional standards, and statutory watchdog bodies.
Option (d) represents an internal hierarchical reporting line (upward reporting from subordinate teachers to the administrative head).

questions.question_english: When an educational administrator employs the Eisenhower Matrix for professional time management, into which quadrant does responding to a student's sudden and severe medical emergency fall?
options_english: Quadrant II: Important but Not Urgent
Quadrant I: Urgent and Important
Quadrant III: Urgent but Not Important
Quadrant IV: Neither Urgent nor Important
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). The Eisenhower Matrix (popularized by Stephen Covey) classifies tasks along two dimensions: Urgency (requiring immediate attention) and Importance (contributing significantly to institutional objectives, values, and well-being).
Quadrant I (Do First): Urgent and Important—crises, medical emergencies, pressing safety issues.
Quadrant II (Schedule): Not Urgent but Important—strategic planning, curriculum development, teacher training.
Quadrant III (Delegate): Urgent but Not Important—interruptions, certain phone calls, minor immediate requests.
Quadrant IV (Eliminate): Not Urgent and Not Important—time wasters, non-essential trivia.
A severe medical emergency of a student poses immediate life-safety risk and carries immense institutional significance, making it squarely a Quadrant I (Urgent and Important) priority requiring immediate personal intervention.

- चतुर्थांश II (महत्वपूर्ण परंतु तात्कालिक नहीं): दीर्घकालिक नियोजन, शिक्षक विकास, संस्थागत सुधार।

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): A Principal who exhibits high ‘Initiating Structure’ and high ‘Consideration’ is generally considered highly effective according to the Ohio State studies.
Reason (R): Such a leader establishes clear roles and expectations while simultaneously fostering a supportive and warm environment for staff.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true: The Ohio State Leadership Studies isolated two independent behavioral dimensions: 'Initiating Structure' (task orientation, organizing work, clarifying goals, defining procedures) and 'Consideration' (relationship orientation, mutual trust, respect, warmth, concern for employees' well-being). Empirical research demonstrates that leaders who score high on both dimensions ('High-High' leaders) consistently attain high subordinate satisfaction, superior team performance, and reduced turnover.
Reason (R) is true: The reason high-high leadership leads to optimal outcomes is precisely because it balances task execution with human relationship needs. The leader provides explicit structure and standard operating guidelines (Initiating Structure) while maintaining a compassionate, supportive workplace climate (Consideration). Thus Reason (R) provides the direct causal explanation for Assertion (A).

अभिकथन (A) सत्य है: ओहियो स्टेट नेतृत्व अध्ययनों (Ohio State Leadership Studies) ने नेतृत्व व्यवहार के दो स्वतंत्र और प्रमुख आयामों की पहचान की थी: 'संरचना आरंभ' (Initiating Structure—कार्य/टास्क उन्मुख व्यवहार) और 'सहानुभूति/विचारशीलता' (Consideration—संबंध उन्मुख व्यवहार)। इन अध्ययनों में पाया गया कि जो नेता इन दोनों आयामों में उच्च स्तर ('High-High') प्रदर्शित करते हैं, वे अपने संगठन में उच्चतम प्रभावशीलता, बेहतर कार्य प्रदर्शन और उच्च संतुष्टि प्राप्त करते हैं।

questions.question_english: Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 mandates the constitution of a School Management Committee (SMC) in every specified school. questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). According to Section 21(1) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, basic schools (except unaided private schools) must constitute a School Management Committee (SMC) comprising local authority representatives, parents/guardians, and school teachers. The statute explicitly mandates that at least three-fourths (75%) of the total members of the SMC shall be parents or guardians of children admitted to the school. Furthermore, proportionate representation must be accorded to parents of children from disadvantaged groups and weaker sections. Additionally, the Act mandates that at least 50% of the overall committee members must be women. The 25% quota in option (a) relates to the reservation of entry-level seats for economically weaker and disadvantaged children in private unaided schools under Section 12(1)(c), not SMC parental composition.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following core operational characteristics of a prominent management philosophy:
I. It represents an ongoing, continuous journey of organizational improvement rather than a one-time project.
II. It demands total commitment and active participation across all hierarchical levels, from senior executives to frontline staff.
III. It places relentless emphasis on process optimization and meeting the expectations of external and internal beneficiaries.
These characteristics best describe which management system?
options_english: Management by Exception (MBE)
Classical Bureaucratic Administration
Programmed Decision Making
Total Quality Management (TQM)
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Total Quality Management (TQM), pioneered by figures like W. Edwards Deming and Joseph Juran, is a comprehensive management philosophy centered on three core tenets:
1. Continuous Improvement (Kaizen): Quality is not an endpoint or a periodic audit, but an ongoing, relentless process of institutional refinement.
2. Total Employee Involvement: Quality is everyone's responsibility; frontline staff, teachers, support personnel, and executive leadership are all actively engaged in identifying problems and improving workflows.
3. Customer/Stakeholder Focus: All processes are aligned toward satisfying or exceeding stakeholder (student, parent, societal) needs.
Option (a), Management by Exception, is a control system where managers intervene only when operational performance significantly deviates from established standards. Option (b), Bureaucratic Administration, emphasizes rigid rules, functional specialization, and strict hierarchy. Option (c), Programmed Decision Making, refers to routine, repetitive decision procedures governed by established decision rules.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। संपूर्ण गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन (Total Quality Management - TQM), जिसे डब्ल्यू. एडवर्ड्स डेमिंग और जोसेफ जुरान जैसे विचारकों ने प्रतिपादित किया, एक समग्र संस्थागत दर्शन है जो तीन प्रमुख स्तंभों पर आधारित है:
1. सतत सुधार: गुणवत्ता कोई एक बार का लक्ष्य नहीं बल्कि संस्थागत प्रक्रियाओं को बेहतर बनाने की एक निरंतर यात्रा है।
2. सभी की सक्रिय भागीदारी: गुणवत्ता केवल शीर्ष प्रबंधन का नहीं बल्कि संस्था के प्रत्येक सदस्य (शिक्षकों, कर्मचारियों और प्रशासकों) का सामूहिक दायित्व है।
3. ग्राहक/हितधारक संतुष्टि: सभी शैक्षिक प्रक्रियाओं का लक्ष्य विद्यार्थियों, अभिभावकों और समाज की अपेक्षाओं को पूरा करना और उन्हें उत्कृष्ट अनुभव प्रदान करना होता है।
विकल्प (a) अपवाद द्वारा प्रबंधन केवल मानकों से महत्वपूर्ण विचलन होने पर हस्तक्षेप करने की नियंत्रण प्रणाली है। विकल्प (b) नौकरशाही प्रशासन नियमों की कठोरता और पदसोपान पर केंद्रित है। विकल्प (c) प्रक्रमित निर्णय नियमित व दोहरावदार निर्णयों से संबंधित है।

questions.question_english: In organizational decision-making theory, which of the following best characterizes a 'programmed decision' made by a school administrator?

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Trait Theory
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Preventive supervision in educational management relies primarily on identifying pedagogical errors after they occur and penalizing the teachers involved.
Reason (R): The primary objective of preventive supervision is to foresee potential instructional challenges and proactively guide teachers to avoid pedagogical pitfalls.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
- Assertion (A) is false: Preventive supervision is proactive and supportive, not reactive or punitive. An approach that waits for pedagogical errors to occur and subsequently penalizes educators is known as punitive or fault-finding (corrective/authoritarian) supervision, which stifles innovation and creates anxiety.
- Reason (R) is true: The fundamental rationale of preventive supervision is anticipatory guidance. Supervisors analyze curriculum requirements, foresee common pedagogical obstacles or classroom management hurdles, and provide timely workshops, co-planning, and mentorship so that teachers avoid instructional mistakes beforehand.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परंतु कारण (R) सही है।
- अभिकथन (A) गलत है: निवारक पर्यवेक्षण (Preventive Supervision) की प्रकृति अग्रसक्रिय और सहयोगात्मक होती है, न कि दंडात्मक। शिक्षण त्रुटियां होने के बाद शिक्षकों को दंडित करना दोषदर्शी या दंडात्मक पर्यवेक्षण (Punitive Supervision) कहलाता है, जो शिक्षकों में भय पैदा करता है और नवाचार को रोकता है।
- कारण (R) सही है: निवारक पर्यवेक्षण का केंद्रीय उद्देश्य संभावित शिक्षण कठिनाइयों और चुनौतियों का पहले से आकलन करना तथा कार्यशालाओं, पाठ-नियोजन और परामर्श के माध्यम से शिक्षकों को अग्रिम मार्गदर्शन देना है ताकि शिक्षण त्रुटियों से समय रहते बचा जा सके।

questions.question_english:
Read the case given below and answer the question that follows:
Case: The school is facing a sudden shortage of teaching staff due to an epidemic. The Principal rapidly reassesses the timetable, merges smaller sections where viable, and utilizes library and sports periods creatively to ensure no class is left unattended.
This action demonstrates the Principal’s effectiveness in:
options_english: Standardized routine programmed administrative decision-making
Deliberately evading active responsibility and ignoring systemic problems
Proactive crisis management and dynamic operational resource allocation
Escalating operational duties to superior authorities through upward delegation
questions.explanation_english:
A key competency of an educational manager is contingency management and non-programmed decision-making during institutional crises. When an unexpected shock—such as an epidemic causing a severe staffing shortage—threatens instructional operations, standard routines cannot resolve the crisis. By immediately restructuring schedules, consolidating sections where feasible, and redeploying co-curricular personnel and slots, the Principal exemplifies proactive crisis management and dynamic resource allocation. This swift intervention ensures uninterrupted pupil supervision, prevents academic disruptions, and stabilizes operations.
- Option A is incorrect because programmed decisions apply only to repetitive, highly structured routine situations with pre-set algorithms.
- Option B is incorrect because the Principal is taking assertive, hands-on initiative.
- Option D is incorrect because the administrator resolves the issue internally at the school level rather than passing the buck to higher ministry authorities.

शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में आकस्मिक संकटों और अनपेक्षित परिस्थितियों का प्रभावी समाधान करना एक महत्वपूर्ण योग्यता है। जब किसी महामारी के कारण अचानक शिक्षकों की भारी कमी हो जाती है, तो यह एक गैर-प्रोग्राम्ड (असामान्य) संकट की स्थिति होती है। ऐसी परिस्थिति में प्राचार्य द्वारा समय-सारणी को तुरंत पुनर्व्यवस्थित करना, कक्षाओं का तार्किक विलय करना और पुस्तकालय व खेल के समय का रचनात्मक उपयोग करके सभी कक्षाओं की निगरानी सुनिश्चित करना 'सक्रिय संकट प्रबंधन' (Proactive Crisis Management) और 'गतिशील संसाधन आवंटन' (Dynamic Resource Allocation) को दर्शाता है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि यह कोई दैनिक या नियमित (प्रोग्राम्ड) निर्णय नहीं है, बल्कि एक असाधारण स्थिति का समाधान है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि प्राचार्य समस्या की उपेक्षा नहीं कर रहे हैं बल्कि सक्रिय रूप से समाधान निकाल रहे हैं।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि प्राचार्य ने समस्या को उच्चाधिकारियों पर टालने के बजाय स्वयं स्थानीय स्तर पर प्रबंधित किया है।
